CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.KasujZestawienia(@GIDNumer INT) AS BEGIN
delete cdn.ZestKSWyniki where ZKW_ZKENumer = @GIDNumer delete cdn.ZestKSDef where ZKD_GIDNumer = @GIDNumer delete cdn.ZestKSElem where ZKE_GIDNumer = @GIDNumer delete cdn.ZestKSNag where ZKN_GIDNumer = @GIDNumer delete cdn.ZestKSZmienne where ZKZ_GIDNumer IN (select ZKO_GIDNumer from cdn.ZestKSWidok where ZKO_ZKNTyp = 2784 AND ZKO_ZKNNumer = @GIDNumer) delete cdn.ZestKSKolumny where ZKK_GIDNumer IN (select ZKO_GIDNumer from cdn.ZestKSWidok where ZKO_ZKNTyp = 2784 AND ZKO_ZKNNumer = @GIDNumer) delete cdn.ZestKSWidok where ZKO_ZKNTyp = 2784 AND ZKO_ZKNNumer = @GIDNumer
END
